channel.title: Reserve Protocol governance digest
channel.description: Independent daily summary of public forum activity in the Reserve Protocol, compiled by Anode Research.

item.title: Reserve Protocol governance digest: 2026-10-28
item.description: sagix.io supports the vlRSR proposal-spam protection IP but requests a 3-month lock-up for legacy DTFs, citing an active attack on ixEDEL.

item.title: Reserve Protocol governance digest: 2026-10-27
item.description: Proposal-spam protection for vlRSR governance promoted to IP with voting Oct 28-30; eUSD mandate and methodology V2 passed its on-chain vote.

item.title: Reserve Protocol governance digest: 2026-10-26
item.description: No new topics or posts on the Reserve Protocol forum in this window.

item.title: Reserve Protocol governance digest: 2026-10-25
item.description: The OPEN Stablecoin DTF proposal to raise its proposal threshold and quorum has moved onchain in three parts.

item.title: Reserve Protocol governance digest: 2026-10-24
item.description: No new topics or posts on the Reserve Protocol forum in this window.

item.title: Reserve Protocol governance digest: 2026-10-23
item.description: Two new RFCs opened on eUSD: a staking and overcollateralization consultation by Raphael_Anode (Anode) and a Revenue Share Programme update from ham.

item.title: Reserve Protocol governance digest: 2026-10-22
item.description: Two RFCs on OPEN governance updated: a 4% proposal threshold and 15% quorum proposed, and a candidate StakingVault deployed.

item.title: Reserve Protocol governance digest: 2026-10-21
item.description: No new topics or posts on the Reserve forum in this window.

item.title: Reserve Protocol governance digest: 2026-10-20
item.description: The eUSD Methodology for USD3 RFC was withdrawn after the announced depreciation of USD3, and tbrent confirmed a new candidate vault for the OPEN proposal-spam protection upgrade at a 5% threshold and 15% quorum.

item.title: Reserve Protocol governance digest: 2026-10-19
item.description: 0xJMG opened an RFC to raise OPEN's proposal threshold and quorum, and replied to the OPEN proposal-spam protection RFC; Raphael_Anode (Anode) posted on eUSD revenue share and delegate compensation.

item.title: Reserve Protocol governance digest: 2026-10-18
item.description: No new topics or posts on the Reserve forum in this window.

item.title: Reserve Protocol governance digest: 2026-10-17
item.description: tbrent opened two RFCs proposing proposal-spam protection upgrades to Reserve Governor 1.1.0 for OPEN governance on Ethereum and ABX governance on Base.

item.title: Reserve Protocol governance digest: 2026-10-16
item.description: gi0rgos_Eureka added a supportive reply to the RFC on adopting the eUSD methodology for USD3 and the collateral basket change.

item.title: Reserve Protocol governance digest: 2026-10-15

item.title: Reserve Protocol governance digest: 2026-10-14
